definitions.explanation: Describes explaining, describing, or examining something with meticulous attention to every detail, leaving nothing out.

examples.japanese: {事細|ことこま}かに⟦{説明|せつめい}する→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{様子|ようす}→様子：01521_yousu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{事細|ことこま}かに⟦{話|はな}して→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: She told me about the trip in great detail.

examples.japanese: ⟦{報告書|ほうこくしょ}→報告書：06744_houkokusho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経緯|けいい}→経緯：02782_keii⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{事細|ことこま}かに⟦{記|しる}されていた→記す：14238_shirusu⟧。
examples.english: The report described the circumstances of the accident in minute detail.

notes:
A somewhat literary adverb that emphasizes thoroughness and completeness in describing or explaining something. The underlying な-adjective {事細|ことこま}か can also be used attributively ({事細|ことこま}かな⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {事細|ことこま}かに⟦{説明|せつめい}する→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧: to explain in detail
- {事細|ことこま}かに⟦{報告|ほうこく}する→報告する：05644_houkokusuru⟧: to report in detail
- {事細|ことこま}かに⟦{記録|きろく}する→記録する：25341_kirokusuru⟧: to record in detail
- {事細|ことこま}かに⟦{尋|たず}ねる→尋ねる：01175_tazuneru⟧: to ask in detail

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{詳|くわ}しく→詳しい：02483_kuwashii⟧: in detail — the most common, everyday way to say this
- ⟦{細|こま}かく→細かい：01245_komakai⟧: in detail, finely — focuses on small divisions or precision
- ⟦{逐一|ちくいち}→逐一：07517_chikuichi⟧: one by one, point by point — emphasizes going through each item individually
